title: How many steps does the 16-channel VHE model need to reach 0.4x on a fixed 8-pair batch?
hypothesis: The loss in EXP-0026 was still falling at step 600 (0.530x of first), so the budget, not the capacity, was the binding constraint. At lr 3e-3 the same fixed 8-pair batch crosses 0.4x of its first total before step 2000, and the crossing step is the number worth recording.
notes: Same fixed 8 pairs, lr 3e-3, 2000 steps, 73.89 s. The preregistered 'some step at or below 0.4x' criterion is met at step 1850 (1.4535) yet step 2000 is 1.5648 (0.418x), so this is a conditional pass and must not be described as converged. log_magnitude holds the plateau (1.2786 of 1.5648 = 82%); spectral_convergence fell to 0.1711 and periodicity to 0.0367. GPU peak memory not recorded. No listening test.
